title: XTRA POWER Impact Drill Machine, 13MM, 650 Watt, Electric Power Tool XPT-422
description: The XTRA POWER 13MM Impact Drill is a robust and reliable electric power tool designed for both professional and DIY applications. Powered by a 650 Watt motor, it delivers a no-load speed of 1800 RPM, ensuring efficient and consistent performance across a wide range of drilling tasks. The 13MM chuck capacity allows compatibility with a variety of drill bits, making it suitable for drilling into wood, metal, masonry, and concrete surfaces. The impact function provides the extra force needed to tackle tough materials with ease, reducing effort and saving time on demanding jobs. Ergonomically designed for a comfortable grip, this drill helps minimise fatigue during extended use. Whether you are working on home improvement projects or heavy-duty construction tasks, the XTRA POWER Impact Drill is a dependable companion in your toolkit. Its sturdy build ensures long-lasting durability, making it a worthwhile addition for anyone seeking a powerful and versatile drilling solution.
